## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND together with CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk is rotating into cyclicals/commodities rather than a clean risk-on or risk-off sweep.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress EASING: HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16% RECOVERY) shows incremental relief. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and reflation via CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND are driving flows.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND leaves Stocks vs Bonds (↑ rising) supportive but not extreme. Dollar softening: UUP (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND reduces policy headwinds.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Materials/Financials leading: XLB (Materials proxy 1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (Financials proxy 1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND; Tech remains constructive: XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities showing weakness: XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND — style: cyclicals/value nudging growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND while EM is catching up: EEM (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.62%) RECOVERY — China remains patchy versus broader EM strength.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation waning: Speculation Index falling and IBIT (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND shows crypto flows but lower speculative breadth; IWM (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.91%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND indicate selective risk-on in smaller and thematic names.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation theme: CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND show strong commodity-led flows supporting cyclical sectors.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed but constructive: XLE (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY; natural gas volatile: UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY — watch dispersion within energy exposures.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad participation with SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION and Staples XLP (1W: -0.42% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION are minor rotational signals to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and materials: XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while maintaining exposure to tech: XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to defensives such as XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND where appropriate.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND and Financials XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND if commodity strength persists. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION on rotational flows.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND for reflation signals. BEARISH/RISK: Natural gas UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY remains volatile and oil BNO (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY is watch-listed for mean-reversion.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (VXX 1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) as a complacency threshold; HYG/LQD ~0.73 (Credit Spread Level 0.7285) to gauge credit health; XLK/XLF ratio ~2.63 (Tech vs Financials Level 2.6345) as a rotation pivot; Gold vs Stocks 0.6037 (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +6.78%) to monitor safe-haven demand.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60% ABOVE TREND) confirm flows into cyclicals and commodities. Materials XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) and Financials XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) showing strength while Utilities XLU (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) shows weakness — monitor XLY/XLP divergence. Key risk: commodity-driven rotation could reverse credit sentiment if HYG/LQD stalls (HYG 1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16% RECOVERY).
